postCreate: MAIN=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)"); if [ -f "$MAIN/.env" ]; then cp "$MAIN/.env" .env; fi
MAIN=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)"); if [ -e "$MAIN/.rpiv" ]; then ln -sfn "$MAIN/.rpiv" .rpiv; fi
MAIN=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)"); if [ -e "$MAIN/.references" ]; then ln -sfn "$MAIN/.references" .references; fi
MAIN=$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)"); if [ -e "$MAIN/.pi" ]; then ln -sfn "$MAIN/.pi" .pi; fi
